hypothesis: A coherent finite coordinate map provides a better initialization for learning symmetry-transformed relations than finite pair/ranking pretraining.
scope: Both sources used identical fixed training states and pretraining update budgets. Source weights selected on finite training geometry, not heldout scores. Both followups use fresh Adam, the same new-pose stream, losses, architecture and update budget. Fixed fit poses are familiar from pretraining; validation/test remain excluded. Total updates include pretraining, so do not compare with the earlier random-initialization augmented control as a matched total-budget comparison. This is still transfer of known relative relations, not a full global map.
